{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any are refunded — they should not be included in revenue
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Summary of revenue per channel, excluding QA and refunded orders
# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
cleaned_sales = sales[(sales['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
revenue_by_channel = cleaned_sales.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum()

print(revenue_by_channel)"}
